maddeler.e:
نتخالف (form VI)
# نَتَخَالَفُ (nataḵālafu) /na.ta.xaː.la.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَخَالَفَ (taḵālafa)
# نَتَخَالَفَ (nataḵālafa) /na.ta.xaː.la.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَخَالَفَ (taḵālafa)
# نَتَخَالَفْ (nataḵālaf) /na.ta.xaː.laf/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَخَالَفَ (taḵālafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
